Get Started Fitzgerald Lawn Solutions FREE ESTIMATE Home Services About Us Contact Gallery fitzgeraldlawnsolutions@gmail.com (912) 536-9887 Lawn Care & Landscape Services Fitzgerald Lawn Solutions performs the highest quality landscape and lawn maintenance for residential properties throughout the Fitzgerald area. Services offered range from lawn mowing to landscape maintenance and everything in between. If your shrubs are overgrown and your beds are full of weeds we can transform your landscape with property cleanup. FREE ESTIMATE LAWN MAINTENENCE Lawn Maintenence includes mowing, edging of concrete surfaces, string trimming perimeter of property/garden beds, and blowing debris from hard surfaces. One-Time, Weekly and Bi-Weekly services offered. Learn More >> SHRUB/HEDGE TRIMMING Shrub/Hedge trimming service includes properly trimming any shrubs, hedges and ornamental trees. One-time, Monthly, and Quarterly maintenance services offered. Learn More >> LEAF & PINE NEEDLE REMOVAL Leaf & Pine Needle Removal includes cleaning leaves, undesirable pine needles, and other debris from manicured turf and garden beds. One-time, Bi-weekly, Monthly, and Quarterly Services offered Learn More >> PROPERTY CLEANUP The typical property cleanup includes pulling weeds, trimming bushes, leaf cleanup, and Mowing. Typically, a One-time service at the beginning/end of the growing season or, if necessary, before beginning routine lawn maintenance. Storm cleanups are also offered. Learn More >> MULCH & PINE STRAW INSTALLATION Mulching/Pine straw Installation includes weeding the flower beds if needed. Then, spreading chosen mulch or pine straw to desired depth. Learn More >> GARDEN BED DEFINING Garden bed edges are defined, establishing a sharp edge between turf and bed. Learn More >> Fitzgerald Lawn Solutions fitzgeraldlawnsolutions@gmail.com (912) 536-9887 232 Walker Ave. Fitzgerald, GA 31750 ©2021 by Fitzgerald Lawn Solutions
